To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the multi layer grid map representation is beneficial to predict semantic information of sparse 3D LiDAR data, the combination of multi layer grid maps from multiple LiDAR scans allows us to predict dense semantic grids and that our approach achieves state of the art results for semantic segmentation based on a LiDAR input.
we propose a novel multi layer grid map representation for semantic segmentation of LiDAR data.
we can achieve a mean IoU of 48% on the SemanticKITTI validation set using only sparse LiDAR data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transformation of LiDAR measurements to a grid map representation, which is used for semantic segmentation.
the development and evaluation of a semantic segmentation method for sparse LiDAR point clouds based on a top view grid representation.
the development of a dense semantic grid representation of the environment and the development of a method to combine semantic information from multiple LiDAR scans.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a single layer approach is not sufficient to exploit the full information from the input data.
the multi layer representation outperforms the single layer one, but the single layer one outperforms the multi layer one.
our method performs on par with the state-of-the-art methods on the SemanticKITTI validation set.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose to use a grid map representation for LiDAR data and demonstrate its benefit in the task of semantic segmentation.
we are able to predict a dense 360deg semantic grid map from a single sparse LiDAR scan using a deep learning architecture from the image domain.
we are proposing a new representation for LiDAR based semantic segmentation and demonstrate the benefit over a single layer approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we are able to predict a dense 360deg semantic representation of the environment using a multi layer grid representation.
the proposed multi layer grid map representation allows to predict a semantic segmentation with a higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art.
the grid map framework allows us to use the power of well studied image based architectures to approach the task semantic segmentation from a LiDAR only perspective.
